_comment: Golden table for the shape twin. Identical copy in each repo: work/tests/domain/shape-twin.fixture.json and backend/tests/Anchal.Tests/CommissionerMonitoring/Domain/shape-twin.fixture.json. Each side asserts its own shape tables against this file, so the two cannot diverge without a test going red. Field ORDER is part of the contract. serviceNames is the Hindi service master: the frontend asserts services.json against it, the backend asserts the names MonitoringProvisioner seeds. Renaming a service means editing this file, services.json and ServiceNames together. fieldVisitFields is the per-service visit form structure (key, type, integer marker, option values, in order; every field is optional and none carries a required flag, because nothing honours one) for the eight field-work services: the frontend asserts src/shared/field-visit-fields.json against it, the backend asserts MonitoringFieldDefinitions. An integer:true field takes a whole number only (the three counts: dogsPicked, dogsNeutered, treeCount); the form's input and the server's validation both follow it. Labels and Hindi are frontend-only and not in this file. Changing a field means editing this file, field-visit-fields.json and MonitoringFieldDefinitions together. A unit change is a NEW key, never a label edit: a label is read from today's definition for every row ever filed. fieldVisitBounds is the limit a details value is held to (text, text area, number): the frontend asserts src/shared/field-visit-bounds.json against it, the backend asserts MonitoringFieldVisitService.Details* against it.
